budget_items.topic: Turkey Hill asbestos abatement funding in state budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The state budget includes funds for the Turkey Hill asbestos abatement, which can be re-appropriated to other capital projects to cover phase 2 of 3.
budget_items.quote: also in state budget $130k for the turkey hill asbestos abatement.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Public commenter questioned whether debt and a Tri-Town Landing special stabilization item should be included in the total on which the 5% stabilization contribution is calculated; the chair said the 5% is of the total omnibus budget.
budget_items.quote: it was a total dollar amount and 5% of that dollar amount was going into the stabilization

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Public commenter said non-exempt debt should be paid down rather than holding as much money for rainy days.
budget_items.quote: for the past 10 years all he had heard about is our non-exempted debt

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Marc Luescher's review of spending compares ten similar Massachusetts towns over 2013, 2014 and 2015 across Police, Fire and Education.
budget_items.quote: marc focused on 3 years and 3-4 expenditures.
